summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K attaching summarized minutes of a Board of Directors meeting held on May 28, 2026. The board resolved to pay interest on capital to stockholders in the amount of R$0.36188 per share, net of 17.5% withholding tax (R$0.298551 per share for exempt stockholders). The record date is June 18, 2026, with ex-rights trading from June 19, 2026; payment credited on June 29, 2026. This is a routine capital return distribution, not a special-situation event. No adviser or recommendation is mentioned. This is equivalent to a US regular dividend or interest-on-capital announcement.
